Migrated from canardlapin/scalafim Mote bd-01KY5P208FN02GRYF4MG943V1Y on 2026-08-01 after HalfFlow ownership moved to canardlapin/reframe4s.
Source status: open. Source created_at: 2026-07-22T19:50:18.127920Z.

Project sparse midpoint tangent observations into one dense velocity. Estimate a robust confidence-weighted background translation, subtract it at seeds, normalized-Gaussian smooth only residual tangents with a weak zero-residual prior, perform one Cauchy or Huber IRLS reweight, and restore the global background.

Acceptance: identical 12 mm translation seeds yield an approximately constant 12 mm velocity across the full work domain, including far from matches; translation and infinitesimal rotation do not acquire artificial boundary strain; projection is equivariant to correspondence order and common coordinate translation; isolated outliers lose influence after one reweight; missing/low-confidence regions approach background motion rather than identity; all outputs are finite; strain/Jacobian predictors remain safe on analytic fixtures; portable JVM/Scala.js tests compare the fast implementation with a direct reference. Reuse image normalized Gaussian kernels; add no private registration convolution family.
set.title: BasinBridge B2: background-plus-residual tangent projector
